items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Semantic table with a required caption, scoped column/row headers, sortable headers (button + aria-sort, polite status, optional third state, 2 px under-rule), kit-Checkbox selection column, empty and skeleton-loading rows, truncating cells, resizable columns (window splitter on <col>), optional sticky header, stepped row arrival, and dense/comfortable density. The scroll wrapper is a focusable region only while it overflows.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose DataTable (caption required), DataTableHeader, DataTableBody, DataTableRow, DataTableHeadCell (sortable, sortDirection, onSortChange) and DataTableCell (numeric). Density is set with density="dense" | "comfortable"; zebra is on by default (zebra={false} to turn off). v4: DataTableSelectCell/DataTableSelectAll (label required; mirror checked as data-selected on the row), DataTableEmpty (colSpan), DataTableBody loading/loadingRows/loadingColumns/loadingSelect, stream/streamKey, DataTableCell truncate, DataTableRowHeader, DataTableHeadCell sortCycle="three"/resizable with DataTableColgroup+DataTableCol and DataTable resizable, DataTable stickyHeader/sortStatus. MIGRATION (breaking): rows no longer style aria-selected (invalid outside a grid): set data-selected on the row and name the selection with a DataTableSelectCell. Rejected: role=grid cell navigation and aria-rowcount. Body rows stream in by default on mount (stream={false} to opt out).
